headline: Approved $1.6 million loan for parking garage repairs and security; approved consent agenda including ADA reallocation and traffic rule change.
summary: The commission approved a consent agenda covering draft minutes, Former Downtown BHS parking restoration, 240 North Willard St accessibility (ADA) reallocation, and a CPP traffic regulation change. It also approved a $1.6 million loan for repairs and security in the parking garages. Commissioners also discussed crosswalk safety on Colchester Avenue, speeding on Champlain Parkway, and a road name change from Institute Road to Seahorse Lane, but took no votes on these items.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda, including draft minutes, Former Downtown BHS parking restoration, 240 North Willard St accessibility (ADA) reallocation, and CPP traffic regulation change.
